title: Early Writing
introduction: Learn about early writing through simple examples and practice.
definition: Writing letters and short words helps us share ideas. Practise drawing lines, tracing letters and copying words.
rules: Use a pencil and paper to trace letters.

examples.question: Copy the word cat.
steps: Read or listen to the question. Think about what you have learnt.

summary: Writing letters and short words helps us share ideas. Practise drawing lines, tracing letters and copying words.
